procedure_name: Old Age Pension Scheme (NSAP / Vridha Pension)
summary: Monthly direct benefit financial assistance for senior citizens living below poverty line or with limited family support.

steps.title: Verify age & income eligibility
steps.description: Applicant must be aged 60 or above, with annual family income below state poverty threshold.

steps.title: Bank account Aadhaar seeding
steps.description: Ensure bank savings account is active and seeded with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
documents_needed: Bank passbook showing Aadhaar NPCI link

steps.title: Submit application on Social Security portal
steps.description: Apply online or submit at nearest citizen service center (CSC / e-Sewa).

steps.title: Field social worker inquiry
steps.description: Social welfare officer or Anganwadi worker verifies applicant living conditions.

steps.title: Sanction and monthly DBT credit
steps.description: Sanction letter issued; monthly pension (₹1,500 – ₹3,000/month) credited directly to bank account.
